items.text_th: ตอนนี้เมเปิ้ลหนักสุดกี่กิโลคะ
items.text_vn: Giờ cây phong nặng nhất là bao nhiêu ký vậy mọi người?
items.text_en: What's the heaviest maple so far, in kg?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi cây phong nặng nhất hiện giờ bao nhiêu ký.
items.summary_en: Asks how heavy the heaviest maple is right now.

items.text_th: อยากทราบว่าเหรียญที่เอามาสุ่มเดินเต๋าตรงนี้หาเพิ่มได้จากไหนคะ
items.text_vn: Cho mình hỏi đồng xu dùng để đổ xúc xắc đi ô ở đây kiếm thêm ở đâu vậy ạ?
items.text_en: Where can I get more of the coins used for the dice board here?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi kiếm thêm xu để chơi minigame đổ xúc xắc ở đâu.
items.summary_en: Asks where to get more coins for the dice minigame.

items.text_th: 32 ตัวแล้วพื้นม่วงยังไม่ออก ไปต่อหรือพอแค่นี้ ท้อแท้
items.text_vn: 32 con rồi mà nền tím vẫn chưa ra, nên làm tiếp hay dừng ở đây đây, nản quá.
items.text_en: 32 already and still no purple-background one. Keep going or stop here? So discouraging.
items.summary_vn: Than đã 32 lượt mà vẫn chưa ra loại nền tím, đang nản.
items.summary_en: Complains that after 32 tries the purple-tier one still hasn't appeared.

items.text_th: ลงแข่งนี้ปกติส่วนมากเค้าลงวันไหนกันหรอค่ะ ลงตั้งแต่เริ่มเลยหรือลงใกล้ๆวันจบกิจกรรม
items.text_vn: Cuộc thi này mọi người thường đăng ký ngày nào vậy ạ? Đăng ký ngay từ đầu hay gần ngày kết thúc sự kiện?
items.text_en: When do people usually enter this contest? Right at the start or close to the end of the event?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi nên đăng ký cuộc thi cây phong từ đầu hay gần cuối sự kiện.
items.summary_en: Asks whether to enter the maple contest at the start or near the end.

items.text_th: อยากรู้ว่าถ้าเราใช้เข็มฉีดมันจะนับมั้ยคะ แล้วต้นในรูปมันราคาประมาณเท่าไหร่ถ้าโตเต็มที่
items.text_vn: Cho hỏi nếu dùng kim tiêm cho cây thì có được tính không ạ? Với lại cây trong ảnh lớn hết cỡ thì giá khoảng bao nhiêu?
items.text_en: If I use the syringe on it, does it still count? And roughly how much would the tree in the picture sell for when fully grown?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi dùng kim tiêm có được tính trong cuộc thi không và giá cây khi lớn hết cỡ.
items.summary_en: Asks if using the syringe counts in the contest and what the grown tree is worth.

items.text_th:
แบบนี้ประมาณเท่าไหร่
ทอง+รุ้ง ติดต้นยักด้วย
items.text_vn:
Cây thế này khoảng bao nhiêu tiền vậy?
Có cả vàng + cầu vồng, lại còn thành cây khổng lồ nữa.
items.text_en:
Roughly how much is this one worth?
Gold + rainbow, and it turned giant too.
items.summary_vn: Hỏi giá cây khổng lồ có hiệu ứng vàng và cầu vồng.
items.summary_en: Asks the value of a giant plant with gold and rainbow effects.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: แข่งเมเปิ้ล นับยังไงคับ นับอันแรกที่เราขาย หรือขายกี่อันก็ได้แต่นับอันที่ราคาสูงที่สุดคับ
items.text_vn: Cuộc thi cây phong tính thế nào vậy ạ? Tính cây đầu tiên mình bán, hay bán bao nhiêu cây cũng được nhưng chỉ tính cây giá cao nhất?
items.text_en: How does the maple contest count? Is it the first one I sell, or can I sell as many as I want and only the highest price counts?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi cách tính điểm cuộc thi cây phong.
items.summary_en: Asks how the maple contest is scored.

items.text_th:
ในที่สุดก็ติด
 สวยเนอะว่ามั้ย
items.text_vn: Cuối cùng cũng ra hiệu ứng rồi, đẹp ha mọi người?
items.text_en: Finally got the effect. Pretty, isn't it?
items.summary_vn: Khoe cây cuối cùng cũng có hiệu ứng đặc biệt.
items.summary_en: Shows off a plant that finally got a special effect.

items.text_th: ความรู้สึกที่ได้เห็นแสงจ้ากระแทกตาเป็นแบบนี้นี่เอง ได้อวดความจ้ากับเขาบ้างแล้วว ิิ
items.text_vn: Thì ra cảm giác thấy ánh sáng chói lóa đập vào mắt là thế này, cuối cùng mình cũng được khoe độ chói với người ta rồi hihi.
items.text_en: So this is what it feels like to see that blinding glow! Finally I get to show off a shiny one too, hehe.
items.summary_vn: Vui mừng khoe cây có hiệu ứng phát sáng chói.
items.summary_en: Happily shows off a plant with the bright glow effect.

items.text_th: ไม่มงจะงงมากกกก หุหุ
items.text_vn: Mà không ra vương miện (size lớn nhất) thì mình sẽ ngơ lắm luôn, hihi.
items.text_en: If this doesn't get the crown (top size) I'll be so confused, hehe.
items.summary_vn: Khoe cây/vật phẩm và đùa là phải đạt size vương miện.
items.summary_en: Shows off a harvest and jokes it had better reach crown size.

items.text_th: 2 ตัวนี้เงาไซส์ไหนครับ
items.text_vn: Hai con này bóng cá cỡ nào vậy ạ?
items.text_en: What shadow size are these two fish?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi hai con cá này có bóng cỡ nào.
items.summary_en: Asks what shadow size these two fish have.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: แสงมันจ้า ซะเหลือเกินฮ้ะ
items.text_vn: Ánh sáng chói quá trời luôn á.
items.text_en: The glow is just so dazzling.
items.summary_vn: Khoe vật phẩm có hiệu ứng phát sáng chói.
items.summary_en: Shows off an item with a dazzling glow.

items.text_th: 46%โตเท่านี้ ยังมีสิทธิ์โตกว่านี้ไหม???ตื่นเต้นมาก
items.text_vn: Mới 46% mà đã to cỡ này, còn lớn hơn được nữa không ta??? Hồi hộp quá.
items.text_en: Only 46% grown and already this big — can it get even bigger??? So excited.
items.summary_vn: Hào hứng hỏi cây mới 46% có lớn thêm được không.
items.summary_en: Excitedly asks if a plant at 46% growth can get even bigger.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: มีไอเทมหรือสัตว์เลี้ยงตัวไหนเพิ่ม [ตกปลา] เพิ่มอัตราการจับปลาหายาก ไหมครับ
items.text_vn: Có vật phẩm hay thú cưng nào tăng [câu cá] tỉ lệ bắt được cá hiếm không ạ?
items.text_en: Is there any item or pet that boosts [fishing] the chance of catching rare fish?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi vật phẩm/thú cưng nào tăng tỉ lệ câu cá hiếm.
items.summary_en: Asks which items or pets raise the rare-fish catch rate.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: อันดับ1ในตารางแข่งเมเปิ้ลหนักเท่าไหร่กันแล้วคะ
items.text_vn: Hạng 1 trên bảng thi cây phong giờ nặng bao nhiêu rồi mọi người?
items.text_en: How heavy is the #1 on the maple contest board now?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi cây hạng 1 cuộc thi cây phong nặng bao nhiêu.
items.summary_en: Asks how heavy the top maple in the contest is.

items.text_th: สปริงเกอร์อันนี้มันยังมีผลอยู่มั้ยคะ เค้าปักไป1อัน กับสปริงเกอร์แดง25อัน ปลูกเมเปิ้ลไป 30+ ไม่ติดสถานะผีเสื้อซักต้นเลย
items.text_vn: Vòi phun nước này còn tác dụng không vậy? Mình cắm 1 cái với 25 vòi phun đỏ, trồng hơn 30 cây phong mà không cây nào ra hiệu ứng bướm cả.
items.text_en: Does this sprinkler still work? I placed 1 of these plus 25 red sprinklers and planted 30+ maples, and not a single one got the butterfly effect.
items.summary_vn: Thắc mắc vòi phun còn tác dụng không vì trồng 30+ cây phong không ra hiệu ứng bướm.
items.summary_en: Wonders if the sprinkler works since 30+ maples got no butterfly effect.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: งวดนี้รวยยยย
items.text_vn: Đợt này giàu to rồiii.
items.text_en: Getting rich this round!
items.summary_vn: Khoe thu hoạch đợt này được nhiều tiền.
items.summary_en: Shows off a lucrative harvest this round.

items.text_th: ขนาดเมเปิ้ล ใหญ่สุดเท่าไหร่ค่ะ
items.text_vn: Cây phong lớn nhất được cỡ bao nhiêu vậy ạ?
items.text_en: What's the biggest size a maple can get?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi kích thước cây phong lớn nhất.
items.summary_en: Asks the maximum maple size.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: สอบถาม ต้นไม้ 1 ต้น สามารถติดสถานะได้กี่อันคับ
items.text_vn: Cho hỏi 1 cây có thể có tối đa mấy hiệu ứng đặc biệt vậy ạ?
items.text_en: Question: how many special effects can one plant have?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi một cây có tối đa bao nhiêu hiệu ứng đặc biệt.
items.summary_en: Asks how many special effects one plant can have.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: จะย้ายตัวเก่ามาเซิฟ vng แต่ว่าไม่สามารถดาวน์โหลดไฟล์ตรงนี้ได้ค่ะ ในแอป global ปล่อยมานานแล้วมันไม่ขึ้น มีใครมีวิธีแก้ไหมคะ
items.text_vn: Mình muốn chuyển nhân vật cũ sang máy chủ VNG nhưng không tải được file ở chỗ này. Trong app Global để lâu rồi mà nó không hiện lên, có ai biết cách khắc phục không ạ?
items.text_en: I want to move my old character to the VNG server but I can't download the file here. I left it running in the Global app for ages and it never shows up. Anyone know a fix?
items.summary_vn: Không tải được file để chuyển nhân vật từ bản Global sang VNG.
items.summary_en: Can't download the file needed to move a character from Global to VNG.

items.text_th: มีใครเล่นเกมแล้วกระตุกบ้างมั้ยคับ ของผมกระตุกมากคับ
items.text_vn: Có ai chơi game bị giật không ạ? Máy mình giật dữ lắm.
items.text_en: Is anyone else's game stuttering? Mine stutters a lot.
items.summary_vn: Báo game bị giật lag nhiều.
items.summary_en: Reports heavy stuttering in the game.

items.text_th: กิจใหม่ไปตกปลาตรงไหนเหรอคะ
items.text_vn: Sự kiện mới đi câu cá ở đâu vậy ạ?
items.text_en: Where do I go fishing for the new event?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi địa điểm câu cá cho sự kiện mới.
items.summary_en: Asks where to fish for the new event.

items.text_th: ปกติแล้วถ้าเราใช้ดมกลิ่นมันจะวิ่งหาหรือป่าวคะ หรือเราเข้าใจอะไรผิด ใช้ดมกลิ่นแล้วน้องยืนตัวติดกับเราเลย
items.text_vn: Bình thường dùng kỹ năng đánh hơi thì thú cưng có chạy đi tìm không ạ, hay mình hiểu sai gì? Mình dùng đánh hơi xong bé đứng dính sát bên mình luôn.
items.text_en: Normally when you use Sniff, does the pet run off to search? Or am I misunderstanding something? After I used Sniff it just stuck right next to me.
items.summary_vn: Hỏi vì sao thú cưng dùng đánh hơi mà không chạy đi tìm.
items.summary_en: Asks why the pet doesn't go searching after using Sniff.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: เมเปิ้ลที่ปลูกไว้แล้วถ้าเก็บจะขึ้นในตารางมั้ยคะ
items.text_vn: Cây phong đã trồng từ trước, giờ thu hoạch thì có lên bảng xếp hạng không ạ?
items.text_en: If I harvest maples I planted earlier, will they show up on the board?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi cây phong trồng trước khi đăng ký có được tính lên bảng không.
items.summary_en: Asks if maples planted before entering count on the board.

items.text_th:
พึ่งซื้อเบ็ตมา แล้วสุ่มออฟเสริมเล่นๆ แบบกะจะตกเล่นๆไม่จริงจัง มาก สรุป …. มงวัวมาเลย5555555 
 อย่าลืมซื้อเบ็ตนี้นะทุกคนนน มันบอกว่า สัญญาณปลายักษ์จะมา ก็มาจริง55555 ตอนวินาทีสุดท้าย55555
items.text_vn:
Mới mua cần câu, quay chỉ số phụ chơi chơi, định câu cho vui thôi chứ không nghiêm túc lắm. Kết quả… ra luôn con vương miện haha.
Mọi người nhớ mua cần này nha, nó báo "tín hiệu cá khổng lồ sắp tới" là tới thật luôn haha, đúng giây cuối cùng haha.
items.text_en:
Just bought the rod and rolled its bonus stat for fun, planning to fish casually. Result… a crown-size catch, lol.
Don't forget to buy this rod, everyone! It said "giant fish signal incoming" and it really came, lol — at the very last second.
items.summary_vn: Khoe vừa mua cần câu mới đã câu được cá vương miện, khuyên mọi người mua.
items.summary_en: Shows off a crown-size catch with the new rod and recommends it.

items.text_th: เมเปิ้ล40+สปริงแดง40จะยักกี่ต้นมารอดู
items.text_vn: 40 cây phong + 40 vòi phun đỏ, xem sẽ ra bao nhiêu cây khổng lồ nào.
items.text_en: 40 maples + 40 red sprinklers — let's see how many turn giant.
items.summary_vn: Trồng 40 cây phong với 40 vòi phun đỏ, chờ xem ra bao nhiêu cây khổng lồ.
items.summary_en: Planted 40 maples with 40 red sprinklers, waiting to see how many go giant.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ไหนสีทองแสบตาสายรุ้งแบบคนอื่นคะะะ!!
items.text_vn: Đâu rồi màu vàng chói mắt với cầu vồng như người ta vậyyy!!
items.text_en: Where's my eye-searing gold and rainbow like everyone else's?!!
items.summary_vn: Than không ra hiệu ứng vàng/cầu vồng như người khác.
items.summary_en: Complains about not getting gold/rainbow effects like others.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ผมลงตั้งแต่มันมาแต่เก็บวันสุดท้าย
items.text_vn: Mình đăng ký ngay từ lúc có cuộc thi nhưng để ngày cuối mới thu hoạch.
items.text_en: I entered as soon as it started but I'm harvesting on the last day.
items.summary_vn: Chia sẻ đăng ký từ đầu nhưng thu hoạch ngày cuối.
items.summary_en: Says they entered early but will harvest on the last day.

items.text_th: ตัวเองต้องกดลงกิจกรรมก่อนน้า ถ้าไม่ได้กดมันไม่นับให้
items.text_vn: Bạn phải bấm đăng ký sự kiện trước nha, không bấm là không được tính đâu.
items.text_en: You need to sign up for the event first — if you don't, it won't count.
items.summary_vn: Nhắc phải đăng ký sự kiện trước thì mới được tính.
items.summary_en: Reminds that you must register for the event for it to count.

items.text_th:
นับค่ะ ต้นแพงสุดถ้าฉีดเข็มไปราคาก็เพิ่มขึ้นอีก ต้องหาเข็มสถานะแพงๆไปฉีก
ต้นในรูปบอกไม่ได้ค่ะว่าราคาเท่าไหร่ เพราะต้นยักมีหลายขนาดเลยค่ะ ยักมีขนาด 1100+ ถึง 1800+
items.text_vn:
Có tính nha. Cây đắt nhất mà tiêm thêm thì giá còn tăng nữa, phải kiếm kim tiêm hiệu ứng đắt tiền mà tiêm.
Cây trong ảnh thì không nói được giá bao nhiêu vì cây khổng lồ có nhiều cỡ lắm, từ 1100+ đến 1800+.
items.text_en:
Yes, it counts. If you inject your priciest tree its price goes up even more — find a syringe with an expensive effect.
Can't tell the price of the tree in the picture; giant trees come in many sizes, from 1100+ to 1800+.
items.summary_vn: Giải thích kim tiêm làm tăng giá cây và cây khổng lồ có nhiều cỡ.
items.summary_en: Explains syringes raise tree prices and giant trees vary in size.

items.text_th: ต้นขิงนิ ไม่ใช่เมเปิ้ล
items.text_vn: Đây là cây gừng mà, đâu phải cây phong.
items.text_en: That's a ginger plant, not a maple.
items.summary_vn: Chỉ ra cây trong ảnh là gừng chứ không phải cây phong.
items.summary_en: Points out the plant is ginger, not maple.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ติดทองหรือรุ้ง ไม่ต้องดีใจ เพราะจะติดเปียกชื้นมาด้วย ต้องใช้เข็มฉีดล้างยุดีครับ ไม่งั้นราคาตกเยอะ ถ้าขนาดเท่ากัน
items.text_vn: Ra vàng hay cầu vồng cũng đừng mừng vội, vì sẽ dính luôn hiệu ứng ẩm ướt. Phải dùng kim tiêm tẩy đi mới ổn, không thì giá tụt nhiều so với cây cùng cỡ.
items.text_en: Don't celebrate getting gold or rainbow — it also comes with the damp effect. You need a syringe to clear it, otherwise the price drops a lot compared with the same size.
items.summary_vn: Cảnh báo hiệu ứng vàng/cầu vồng kèm ẩm ướt làm giảm giá, cần kim tiêm tẩy.
items.summary_en: Warns gold/rainbow comes with a damp effect that lowers price unless cleared with a syringe.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: เอามาทำไม ไม่บอกให้มันติดเมเปี้ล
items.text_vn: Khoe làm chi, sao không bảo nó ra hiệu ứng cho cây phong đi.
items.text_en: Why show this off? Should've told it to land on a maple instead.
items.summary_vn: Trêu người đăng nên để hiệu ứng rơi vào cây phong.
items.summary_en: Teases that the effect should have landed on a maple.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ส่ายหางคับ
items.text_vn: Bóng vẫy đuôi đó bạn.
items.text_en: It's the tail-wagging shadow.
items.summary_vn: Trả lời đó là bóng cá loại vẫy đuôi.
items.summary_en: Answers that it's the tail-wagging shadow type.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: วอนเซียส เพิ่มอัตราปรากฎตัวของปลาประเภทวาฬคับ
items.text_vn: Vonsias (?) tăng tỉ lệ xuất hiện cá loại cá voi đó bạn.
items.text_en: Vonsias (?) raises the spawn rate of whale-type fish.
items.summary_vn: Gợi ý thú cưng/vật phẩm tăng tỉ lệ xuất hiện cá voi.
items.summary_en: Suggests an item/pet that boosts whale-type fish spawns.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: เท่าที่เคยเห็น เจอแต่เพิ่มโอกาสสำเร็จครับ สำหรับตกปลา
items.text_vn: Theo mình thấy thì chỉ có loại tăng tỉ lệ câu thành công thôi.
items.text_en: From what I've seen, there are only ones that raise the success chance for fishing.
items.summary_vn: Cho biết chỉ thấy vật phẩm tăng tỉ lệ câu thành công.
items.summary_en: Says they've only seen boosts to fishing success chance.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: รอบนี้ไม่ได้แข่งน้ำหนัก แต่แข่งราคาขายสูงสุดค่ะ
items.text_vn: Đợt này không thi cân nặng đâu, mà thi giá bán cao nhất nha.
items.text_en: This round isn't about weight — it's about the highest selling price.
items.summary_vn: Giải thích cuộc thi đợt này tính giá bán cao nhất, không phải cân nặng.
items.summary_en: Explains this contest ranks by highest sale price, not weight.

items.text_th: จนเท่ากับแพ้กิจนี้ สู้คนมีเข็มเยอะยากมาก
items.text_vn: Nghèo là thua sự kiện này rồi, đấu với người có nhiều kim tiêm khó lắm.
items.text_en: Being poor means losing this event — really hard to compete with people who have lots of syringes.
items.summary_vn: Phàn nàn cuộc thi cây phong thiên về người có nhiều kim tiêm.
items.summary_en: Complains the maple contest favors players with many syringes.

items.text_th: ยังติดอยู่นะคะ เราลงไป3+สปริงแดง20อัน ติดประมาณ3-4ต้นอยู่ค่ะ
items.text_vn: Vẫn ra nha. Mình đặt 3 cái + 20 vòi phun đỏ, ra được khoảng 3–4 cây.
items.text_en: It still works. I placed 3 plus 20 red sprinklers and got about 3–4 trees with it.
items.summary_vn: Xác nhận vòi phun vẫn có tác dụng, ra 3–4 cây có hiệu ứng.
items.summary_en: Confirms the sprinkler still works, getting 3–4 trees with the effect.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: เคยเห็นมากสุด1825ครับ
items.text_vn: Mình thấy lớn nhất là 1825.
items.text_en: The biggest I've seen is 1825.
items.summary_vn: Cho biết cây phong lớn nhất từng thấy là 1825.
items.summary_en: Says the biggest maple they've seen is 1825.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: เราช่วยได้นะค่ะ ให้คำปรึกษาฟรี..
items.text_vn: Mình giúp được nha, tư vấn miễn phí..
items.text_en: I can help — free advice..
items.summary_vn: Đề nghị tư vấn miễn phí việc chuyển nhân vật sang VNG.
items.summary_en: Offers free help with moving the character to VNG.

items.text_th:
พลาซ่า & เกาะรีสอร์ท
เวลา :00-15 และ :30-45 (นาทีชีวิตจริง)
เวลาที่วงอยู่ 15 นาที/รอบ
items.text_vn:
Plaza & đảo Resort.
Giờ: phút :00–:15 và :30–:45 (theo giờ thực).
Vòng câu tồn tại 15 phút/lượt.
items.text_en:
Plaza & Resort Island.
Times: minutes :00–:15 and :30–:45 (real time).
The fishing ring stays 15 minutes per round.
items.summary_vn: Hướng dẫn địa điểm và khung giờ câu cá sự kiện.
items.summary_en: Gives the event fishing spots and time windows.

items.text_th: ต้องกดคำสั่ง ตามหา ด้วยคับ
items.text_vn: Phải bấm thêm lệnh "Tìm kiếm" nữa bạn.
items.text_en: You also need to press the "Search" command.
items.summary_vn: Hướng dẫn phải bấm lệnh Tìm kiếm cho thú cưng.
items.summary_en: Explains you must also press the pet's Search command.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ขึ้นแค่ปลูกหลังลงแข่งงับ
items.text_vn: Chỉ tính cây trồng sau khi đăng ký thi thôi nha.
items.text_en: Only plants grown after you enter the contest count.
items.summary_vn: Giải thích chỉ cây trồng sau khi đăng ký mới được tính.
items.summary_en: Explains only plants grown after entering count.

items.text_th: ราคาแรงอยู่นะคะ 54 ทอง
items.text_vn: Giá hơi chát đó, 54 vàng.
items.text_en: It's pretty pricey though — 54 gold.
items.summary_vn: Nhận xét cần câu mới giá khá cao (54 vàng).
items.summary_en: Notes the new rod is pricey at 54 gold.

items.text_th: จะยักประมาณ8-13 ครับ
items.text_vn: Chắc sẽ ra khoảng 8–13 cây khổng lồ.
items.text_en: You'll probably get around 8–13 giants.
items.summary_vn: Ước tính khoảng 8–13 cây thành khổng lồ.
items.summary_en: Estimates about 8–13 will turn giant.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: เบ็ดไม้โหดที่สุดจีงไหมคับ
items.text_vn: Cần câu gỗ là mạnh nhất thật hả mọi người?
items.text_en: Is the wooden rod really the strongest?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi cần câu gỗ có thật sự mạnh nhất không.
items.summary_en: Asks if the wooden rod is really the best.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ได้แมวบ้างมั้ยคะ อยากรู้ความสามารถเสริมค่ะ
items.text_vn: Có ai ra được con mèo chưa ạ? Mình muốn biết chỉ số phụ của nó.
items.text_en: Has anyone gotten the cat? I'd like to know its bonus ability.
items.summary_vn: Hỏi ai có mèo mới để biết chỉ số phụ.
items.summary_en: Asks who got the new cat to learn its bonus ability.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: หาไอดีคับมีเบ็ดมีเรือถูกๆ
items.text_vn: Tìm mua tài khoản có cần câu, có thuyền, giá rẻ.
items.text_en: Looking for a cheap account that has a fishing rod and a boat.
items.summary_vn: Tìm mua tài khoản giá rẻ có sẵn cần câu và thuyền.
items.summary_en: Looking to buy a cheap account with a rod and boat.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: เปิดรับฟาร์มเหรียญแล้ว! Sweet Halloween
items.text_vn: Đã mở nhận cày xu thuê! Sweet Halloween.
items.text_en: Now taking coin-farming orders! Sweet Halloween.
items.summary_vn: Nhận cày thuê xu sự kiện Sweet Halloween.
items.summary_en: Offers paid coin farming for the Sweet Halloween event.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game

Trái cây đủ loại, đủ hiệu ứng

[Selling] garden money, farm coins

items.text_vn: Đã mở nhận cày nông trại thuê rồi nha.
items.text_en: Now taking farming orders.

items.text_th: ตกในทาวน์ได้ใช่ไหมคะ
items.text_vn: Câu trong thị trấn được đúng không ạ?
items.text_en: We can fish in town, right?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi có câu cá sự kiện trong thị trấn được không.
items.summary_en: Asks if the event fishing works in town.

data_health: Thu thập hằng ngày: Facebook, YouTube, TikTok (đã che tên tác giả).
